# Auto-AI-Cluster — Complete Product Documentation

> Production-grade self-hosted autonomous AI agent cluster for 2C4G VPS.
> Docker Compose one-click deploy. n8n workflow engine + PostgreSQL HA + auth system + AI API security gateway.

## Product Overview

Auto-AI-Cluster is a complete, production-ready self-hosted AI infrastructure stack. Designed for solo founders, indie hackers, and small teams who want to run multiple AI workloads on a single $15/mo VPS instead of paying $250+/mo for cloud APIs.

### Core Stack

- **n8n** — Workflow engine with 400+ integrations (scheduling, branching, retries, error handling)
- **PostgreSQL HA** — With WAL archiving, connection pooling, point-in-time recovery
- **Redis** — Queue for burst traffic, prevents OOM on spikes
- **AI Gateway** — Routes between OpenAI, DeepSeek, local LLMs; fallback + rate limiting + cost tracking
- **Auth Server** — RSA-2048 key pairs bound to machine fingerprint; no external IdP needed
- **Nginx** — Edge proxy with rate limiting and TLS termination
- **pgAdmin** — Database management UI

## Technical FAQs

**Q: Can I deploy this on a $5 VPS?**
Minimum spec is 2C4G — roughly $10-15/mo. For $5 plans (1C1G), run a subset without PostgreSQL HA. Upgrade when you grow.

**Q: What's the upgrade path?**
Form-B ($29) to understand architecture → Form-A ($49) to deploy → Enterprise ($6,800/yr) for K8s/multi-tenant.

**Q: Aren't you just selling a Docker Compose file?**
The Compose file is the tip of the iceberg. The auth server (RSA-2048 fingerprint binding), AI gateway with cost tracking, HA PostgreSQL failover config, health check orchestration, monitoring — those take weeks to get right. The entire codebase is open-source (AGPLv3) on GitHub. Form-A packages the validated integration. Form-B is the blueprint to build your own.

**Q: Why should I self-host vs cloud?**
Fixed cost ($17/mo VPS) regardless of traffic volume. No vendor lock-in, no API deprecation, no surprise bills. Full audit trail of every API call and workflow execution. Offline-capable. The cluster pays for itself within the first week for most use cases.
